summary.text: ASA-GF is a glass-fibre-filled acrylonitrile styrene acrylate. Makers sell it for end-use parts such as garden furniture and automotive interiors, and they report excellent resistance to outdoor exposure. Its HDT at 0.45 MPa is 88⁠–⁠98 °C, below its glass transition, and across the layers it keeps 67 % of its flat tensile strength. On the H2C most products need a hardened nozzle.

items.text: The material is reinforced with glass fibers, making it ideal for mechanically stressed components.
DuraPro ASA GF is a weather-resistant and UV-resistant copolymer for industrial applications
Good heat resistance

DuraPro ASA GF offers greater stiffness, improved heat resistance, and lower shrinkage than standard ASA, thanks to glass fiber reinforcement. As with all fiber-reinforced materials, this added rigidity comes with a trade-off in impact resistance and elongation compared to standard ASA, making it best suited to applications where stiffness and dimensional accuracy matter more than flexibility.
